name: Sector identity continuity and cross-requisition applicant correlation

statements: FS-ISAC describes multiple member reports across both applicant and contractor stages and continuing sharing about impersonated and synthetic identities. This supports controls that preserve identity continuity from application through onboarding and active employment, including contractors and staffing vendors.

FS-ISAC says two intelligence reports helped one member identify an applicant who had applied to twelve developer and engineering roles. The safe defensive lesson is to correlate applicant identity and application history across requisitions rather than review each application in isolation.

sources.support: FS-ISAC reports that from November 2024 through February 2025 members received many suspicious job applications believed to be connected to the DPRK remote-worker scheme, and several members found suspicious contractors they believed were remote DPRK IT workers. FS-ISAC describes multiple member reports across both applicant and contractor stages and continuing sharing about impersonated and synthetic identities. This supports controls that preserve identity continuity from application through onboarding and active employment, including contractors and staffing vendors
